What we build for you

How we build

From idea to launched, in four steps.

No mystery, no disappearing for months. You see your project take shape at every step, and you approve it before we move on.

STEP 01

Idea

A free intro call. You describe what you need in plain words — a site, an app, a tool. We talk through what it should do, who it's for, and whether we're the right fit. You get a clear quote before anything starts.

STEP 02

Design

We sketch the screens and the flow first, so you can see and react to your website or app before a line of real code is written. Changes are cheap here — that's the point.

STEP 03

Build

We build it in stages and show you working versions as it grows — not a big reveal at the end. You test it on your own phone and tell us what to adjust.

STEP 04

Launch

We put it live, hand it over, and walk you through using it. After launch we're still here — for fixes, changes and the next idea when you're ready.

Questions

Straight answers, up front.

What kinds of things can Botomatic build?

Websites, web apps, mobile apps and custom business tools — the four services above. If it runs in a browser or on a phone and helps your business, it's in scope. If you're not sure what you need, describe the problem on the intro call and we'll tell you honestly what fits.

How much does a project cost?

Every build is different, so every project starts with a free intro call and a clear written quote before any work begins. No hourly meter running, no surprise invoices — you approve the scope and the price first.

How long will my project take?

It depends on scope — a small business website is a much shorter build than a full web app with logins and payments. Your quote includes a timeline, and because we build in stages, you see working versions along the way rather than waiting for one big reveal.

Do I own my website or app?

Yes. Your website or app, its content and your business data belong to you. We build it, launch it and hand it over — you're never locked in to us to keep it running.

What happens after launch?

We walk you through using what we built, and we stay available for fixes, tweaks and new features. Many clients come back with a second idea once the first one is live — that's how the realtor app and the shift tools grew, too.

Do I have to be in Calgary?

No. Botomatic is based in Calgary and loves working with local businesses in person, but builds for clients anywhere in Canada work just as well over calls and shared previews.
